summary: Phase 1+2 tested end-to-end. All 16 backend pytest cases pass. All frontend flows (home, portfolio filters, FAQ, commission form submission + success, terms, privacy, 404, staff login success/failure with JWT persisted to localStorage as 'vance_admin_token', client portal scaffold, mobile menu) verified.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY were on the same line (no newline), causing EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to be unread and object storage to be disabled. Fixed by inserting a newline; backend restarted; /api/health now returns storage:true and upload+download flow verified.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, works fine for now).
ADMIN_PASSWORD stored as plaintext in .env with a simple string compare — documented as bootstrap-only. For production, hash with bcrypt (passlib is already imported).
Admin JWT is stored in localStorage on frontend — acceptable for MVP but susceptible to XSS; consider httpOnly cookie in later phase.
requests library used synchronously for object storage inside async FastAPI handlers (blocks event loop). For higher concurrency, switch to httpx.AsyncClient.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed commission requests created via API and via UI submission (persisted in Mongo requests collection with status=New). Uploaded reference file(s) persisted in files collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3-6 (admin dashboard, payments, showcase automation, client portal magic-link + realtime) are intentionally not implemented. /admin route resolves to 404 by design. If storage flakiness returns, check /app/backend/.env formatting — a stray line-concat bug caused EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to be missed on the first run.
